title: Spatial State Engine / House OS
invariant: Attach state and action to place, object and transition while preserving manual fallback, provenance and returned evidence.

preferred_lineage.name: BLIGHT / HOUSE — Bendemeer Spatial Ledger v0.1

operational_donor.name: home_os_spatial_state_single.html
operational_donor.role: portable interaction donor, not a new authority
operational_donor.law: Truth before beauty: no visual layer may imply geometric certainty the system does not possess.

authority_split.spatial_engine: geometry, addresses, surfaces, evidence, uncertainty, spatial state projection
authority_split.mqtt: optional event transport; never canonical authority
authority_split.house_field: public-safe static projection; never a control endpoint

bridge_contract: Stable room / surface / object / transition IDs map to Home Assistant entities through an explicit adapter.
Observation and inference remain separate classes.
Manual state changes remain valid when sensors or integrations are absent.
Actions are intents until Home Assistant authorizes and executes them.
Every meaningful change may return evidence / receipt to the FIELD return path.
3D/photogrammetry/world views may be used whenever they remain evidence-bounded projections of the same addressed substrate; inferred geometry must not masquerade as measured geometry.
current_thin_slice: Recover/calibrate the shared spatial substrate: verified XY plan + first-class floor/ceiling/wall surfaces + one useful section + explicit HA entity mapping. 3D may derive immediately from those same IDs.
not_now: sensor-rich inference before geometry is trustworthy

substrate.law: The canonical house model is volumetric/addressed: VOLUME -> SURFACES -> OPENINGS -> OBJECTS/ANCHORS -> OBSERVATIONS/ACTIONS -> EVIDENCE.
substrate.rule: 2D and 3D are projections, not rival sources of truth. Any projection is allowed when identity, provenance and uncertainty survive it.

operational_head.exactness: Reconstructed from recovered Sep 3 interface/spec evidence plus the exact Sep 9 single-HTML donor; not claimed to be the exact lost Sep 3 file.

open_identity_conflict.later_current_house_record: current 10A corner unit has also been recorded as 3-room
open_identity_conflict.rule: Preserve both records; verify physical instance and plan orientation before metric calibration.
